_comment_feature: Signature strikes (#605, #645): direction-mapped effects when a configured hero lands a melee hit with any weapon except thrown and ranged. Sauron: Overhead = Slam, Left/Right = Sweep. The Nine: Overhead, Left and Right = Scream. Thrust = a plain hit. Keys are case-insensitive. Full design and every gate: docs/features/signature-strikes.md. A full Bannerlord restart is needed for changes here; the MCM cooldown multiplier applies live.
_comment_enabled: A fallback, read only on a client without MCM settings. Once MCM has loaded, the Combat Mechanics group's Signature Strikes toggle (default on) owns this switch and the value here is not consulted. A dedicated server uses taom-server-settings.json instead.
_comment_shieldBlockedMultiplier: Fraction of the damage basis kept when the triggering hit landed on a shield, and of a ring victim's damage while that victim is shield-blocking (a blocking victim is never knocked down). 0 to 1. Shared by every signature.
_comment_killImmuneRaces: FaceGen race names an instant kill (a strike's killChance) never takes (#1359). The kill also skips a hero, the player, the team's general, any signature bearer and anything that is not humanoid (a horse or a creature; the test is Agent.IsHuman). Trolls are humanoid, so they are listed here: there is no health cap, because the Long Defeat scales troop health per wave. An unknown name is skipped with a warning; an empty list means no race is immune.
_comment_signatures: One entry per group of heroes. id: names the signature in the log, unique. heroIds: hero StringIds (in a Custom Battle the character's own id, which for a lord is the same). heroSets: named lore groups, only nazgul_nine is known. races: FaceGen race names. An agent carries the first signature whose heroIds or heroSets name it, else the first whose races do. cooldowns: seconds per strike kind (Slam, Sweep, Scream), per attacker, in mission time, 0.5 to 120; every kind a strike uses needs an entry, and the directions that share a kind share its timer. strikes: one profile per swing direction. kind: Slam, Sweep or Scream. origin: Impact centres the ring on the hit point, Self on the attacker. outerRadius / innerRadius in metres (0.1 to 15, inner <= outer): full effect inside inner, one ninth at outer, the engine's own boulder curve. damageFraction (0 to 1): share of the hit's damage a ring victim takes before falloff. worldHitBaseDamage (0 to 500): damage basis when the swing hits the ground instead of a foe, 0 = a ground hit does nothing. magnitude (0 to 500): blow impulse on ring victims. knockDown: ring victims fall (riders are dismounted) and the struck foe always falls. knockBack: ring victims and the struck foe are staggered back. fearMorale (0 to 100): one-shot morale drain on ring victims and the struck foe, before tier and race resistance, 0 = none. killChance (0 to 1, default 0): chance a clean hit kills the struck foe outright, rolled on the next mission tick; it needs an unshielded humanoid victim (not a horse or a creature) and a hit that did damage; the roll also skips a victim whose race ability shrugs off blows. sound: a module_sounds.xml name played once per strike at the attacker's head, omit for none.

signatures._comment_balance: Sauron (#605). Long cooldowns on purpose: a Slam is guaranteed knockdown + ring + fear in one package, and Mike's standing instruction is that Sauron must not be overpowered. Listed by hero id AND by race so the feature survives a data change that drops his race attribute; the race finds him in a Custom Battle.

The Nine (#645): SCREAM on the overhead and both side swings, one 15 s timer per wraith across all three (Mike, 2026-09-23). A ring around the wraith itself: damage, 25 morale before tier and race resistance, a knock-back stagger, no knockdown; the struck foe takes the fear and the stagger too. The hero set names exactly the Nine whatever their race data says; the race (#644) finds them in a Custom Battle as well. Sound: docs/features/signature-strikes.md, Sound provenance.

Aragorn (#1359). Matched by hero id only, so races is empty: a race row would make every unit of that race strike. First-guess numbers for the maintainer to tune. The overhead is the only row with a killChance.

Gimli (#1359). Matched by hero id only. First-guess numbers for the maintainer to tune. His fear is the strike fearMorale here and the war-cry shock of his abilities; the Dread Aura gate stays closed.
